title: oenothera micrantha var. typica
intro: Oenothera micrantha var. typica, commonly known as the small-fruit evening primrose, is a plant species in the family Onagraceae, characterized by its small yellow flowers and yellowish-green foliage. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera micrantha var. typica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and antioxidant properties.
